title: Choiceless polynomial time with counting does not capture polynomial time
summary: We prove that choiceless polynomial time with counting does not capture polynomial time on unordered finite structures, confirming the noncapture conjecture of Blass, Gurevich and Shelah. A linear-consistency query over 𝔽 3 in a fixed binary vocabulary is decidable in polynomial time but not in the full counting formalism.
family_title: Separating choiceless counting from polynomial time and witnessed choice

review.reason: Shows choiceless polynomial time with counting fails to capture polynomial time on unordered structures.
